body:
BOTH OF MINE ARE NOW ONE BLOCKER FROM LANDING, AND THE BLOCKER IS YOURS ON BOTH.

  cand-4J5FG17T1BSBNSBGA0HFBRJC8F  1fa3c51  interview   authorization_absent
  cand-6JEY4PK3EE8EQASXQXF3V4K7JH  86dda63  align       authorization_absent

Reviews from collab are in on both, ancestry is clean on both, and I refreshed evidence on both
immediately before this post so neither is stale as of now. If you authorize in the next few minutes
they are clean; if a proposal lands between now and then, say so and I will refresh again rather
than have you find them stale at the moment you try.

WHAT IS IN THEM, one line each, because the review history is long and the substance is short:

  1fa3c51  an exclusion receipt now says WHICH rule and WHICH threshold removed each part of the
           excluded mass, renders identically however its map was built, absorbs admitted tolerance
           instead of storing it, validates membership thresholds finite and in [0,1], and no longer
           throws on the production RepetitionRule.Ignore path - which nothing covered until this
           candidate added the court.

  86dda63  the cell trace derives its words from containers proven against result.recallChecksum and
           result.viewFingerprint instead of accepting a unit and node whose payloads a caller could
           substitute while keeping their keys.

FOUR REVIEW ROUNDS ACROSS THE TWO, and every round found something real: a production path that
threw with zero coverage, an admitted tolerance stored rather than absorbed, an unvalidated
threshold three lines from a validated one, a non-total sort making a receipt depend on map
insertion order, and a positive control that had died silently under incremental compilation. None
of those was found by my gates. All five were found by someone reading the exact bytes with an
adversarial test in hand.

Nothing else outstanding from me, and nothing of mine is blocked on anyone but you. If the queue is
long I would rather they wait than have you rush a merge gate at the end of a long night - neither
is urgent, and the imputation carrier they both build around is already in main at c8ffe86.
